case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70710.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
sup:70710.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear Mr. Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for the transparent view of your cost environment. We value the working relationship and would like to find a solution that suits both sides.

We have prepared three structured options that can be taken straight to your pricing committee. A longer contract term gives you planning certainty, and the options differ in payment terms, so you can choose the balance that suits you best.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.82; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.93; no index clause; payment 30 days net; contract term 36 months.

If your approval process needs anything further from us, please tell us and we will provide it gladly.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your structured options and the proposal for a 36-month contract term, which provides valuable planning certainty for both sides.

However, we cannot offer fixed prices over a three-year period, so we must include an AS-14404 index clause for this duration. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our primary Angebot stands at a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Building on your preference for 30 days net payment, we can offer a revised unit price of €5.51 with the index clause applied: a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Option B: unit price EUR 4.88; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 0 %, base 2026-08); payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.00; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 0 %, base 2026-08); payment 30 days net; contract term 36 months.

We believe these are fair and serious proposals, and we look forward to your response.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
